applicabilityBasis.summary: mantraUSD is designed as a dollar-denominated payment and settlement token. Its whitepaper names MANTRA International Limited as the BVI designer and operational participant and describes T+2 redemption into USDC, while separately discussing underlying collateral or fiat redemption. Direct redemption is generally restricted to authorized Minters and institutional participants. The document disclaims MANTRA liability and does not establish an unambiguous token-issuer obligation to repay fixed monetary value under GENIUS section 2(22). Payment-stablecoin applicability remains unclear; crypto payout and ecosystem reward distribution alone do not establish exclusion.

genius.notes: The reopened primary whitepaper identifies MANTRA International Limited as the BVI designer and describes MANTRA minting, redemption and discretionary ecosystem reward distribution. It states that holding mantraUSD creates no right to interest, dividends or income. Its operational section describes USDC redemption on a T+2 cycle; risk disclosures restrict direct redemption to authorized institutional participants, disclaim MANTRA liability and identify uncertainty over redemption-right enforceability. These disclosures do not identify an unambiguous fixed-monetary-value legal obligor for all holders, so issuerEntity and issuerDomicile are omitted rather than equating the designer with the legal issuer. A public technical redemption policy and underlying collateral disclosure exist. The M0 dashboard opened as a JavaScript shell and the verifier browser attempt returned ERR_ABORTED; no live reserve figures were extracted. No mantraUSD-specific monthly independent accountant reserve attestation, qualifying GENIUS approval, official application or issuer GENIUS-intent statement was located in the reviewed public sources.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the checked public regulator and issuer sources did not identify a qualifying GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified designation, official GENIUS application or registered foreign-issuer exception for mantraUSD / its unresolved legal issuer. This finding concerns the reviewed public record and does not exclude confidential or unpublished filings. Ordinary licenses and affiliate charter decisions are separate from token-specific GENIUS authorization.
